data.title: Dire Straits
data.notes:
- This particular Canadian pressing has pressing plant ID "Q" etched in deadwax on both sides, but is without [a703109]'s signature "Aℓ" on any of the two sides.
- Printed inner sleeve with a band image and lyrics.

[url=https://www.discogs.com/release/1239084]Release 1239084[/url]: this version has pressing plant ID "Q" and [a703109]'s signature "Aℓ" in deadwax on both sides.

A1 titled 'Down To The Waterline' on back cover vs. 'Down To The Water Line' on A-side label.

[On back cover:]
Recorded at Basing St. Studios, London, Feb. 1978.
Cover painting by Chuck Loyola at Hothouse.
For [a1011285].
Thank you Robert Allan.
℗ 1978 Phonogram Ltd.
Manufactured and distributed by PolyGram Inc., 6000 Cote de Liesse, St. Laurent, Quebec H4T 1E3 - Made in Canada

[On inner sleeve:]
Lyrics reprinted by kind permission of Straightjacket Songs / Rondor Music.

[On labels:]
All songs pub. in UK by Straight Jacket Songs/Rondor Music
